image_description: A folded cloth diaper with a blue, red, and white striped/patterned fabric exterior. It features bright yellow-green vertical fastening straps (likely hook-and-loop) in the center and grey elasticized side wings. The leg openings show gathered ruffles due to elastic casing. The object rests on a green textured carpet background.
